comments_text: Discovery: It can only be expressed when the bacterium was grown on solid culture medium. Chromatigraphic purification, including HPLC. Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that the sequence of this peptide most resembles (84.6% similarity) Streptococcin A-FF22. Chemical modification: Three thioether bonds: residues 8-13; 10-24, and 17-25. In addition, residue 23 is dehydrated. Activity: inhibition zone: Active against nearly all the S. suis strains tested, including antibiotic resistance strains.
title: Purification and Characterization of Suicin 65, a Novel Class I Type B Lantibiotic Produced by Streptococcus suis
